roomVisualRefs.name: roomVisualRefs
roomVisualRefs.description:
Room type -> visuals mapping.
This is used like a dictionary at runtime.

panelPulseSpeed.name: panelPulseSpeed
panelPulseSpeed.description: Pulses per second for the panel color.

panelPulseMultiplier.name: panelPulseMultiplier
panelPulseMultiplier.description: Lighter color multiplier for panel pulse.

tipRotateInterval.name: tipRotateInterval
tipRotateInterval.description: Seconds between tip changes while the loading screen is visible.

leagueGradients.name: leagueGradients
leagueGradients.description: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master and Legend gradients.

landscapeTargetX.name: landscapeTargetX
landscapeTargetX.description: Target X (0..1) from LEFT in landscape.

portraitTargetY.name: portraitTargetY
portraitTargetY.description: Target Y (0..1). By default FROM BOTTOM in portrait.

portraitYFromTop.name: portraitYFromTop
portraitYFromTop.description: If true, portraitTargetY is interpreted FROM TOP.

targetYOffset.name: targetYOffset
targetYOffset.description: World-space Y offset added to target focus point.

leftSideOnly.name: leftSideOnly
leftSideOnly.description: Only allow joystick to start on the left side of the screen.

splitX.name: splitX
splitX.description: Screen split for left/right (0.5 = half screen).

wallRayDistance.name: wallRayDistance
wallRayDistance.description: Max distance to search for the real wall when climbing / trying to auto-grab.

autoGrabMaxDistance.name: autoGrabMaxDistance
autoGrabMaxDistance.description: How close the wall must be to auto-grab (based on hit distance).

wallSnapOffset.name: wallSnapOffset
wallSnapOffset.description: Snap offset away from the wall along wall normal (roughly your capsule radius).

snapAffectsY.name: snapAffectsY
snapAffectsY.description: If true, snapping will also adjust Y (usually causes jitter). Keep false by default.

climbRaycastUpOffset.name: climbRaycastUpOffset
climbRaycastUpOffset.description:
Raycast origin offset for wall detection (meters above entity position).
Entity position is at feet; this moves the wall raycast toward the torso.

mantleCheckInterval.name: mantleCheckInterval
mantleCheckInterval.description: Mantle / ledge assist (air-jump only when near a walkable surface)

autoGrabInputMinDot.name: autoGrabInputMinDot
autoGrabInputMinDot.description: Auto-grab requires input pointing into the wall (dot with wall normal <= -value).

controllerProbeRadius.name: controllerProbeRadius
controllerProbeRadius.description:
Fallback radius used by controller probes when the rigidbody uses child
collision shapes instead of a root capsule collision.

controllerProbeHeight.name: controllerProbeHeight
controllerProbeHeight.description:
Fallback height used by controller probes when the rigidbody uses child
collision shapes instead of a root capsule collision.

normalLocal.name: normalLocal
normalLocal.description: Local-space normal pointing OUT of the wall (box only).

raycastTarget.name: raycastTarget
raycastTarget.description:
Actual rigidbody / collision entity to raycast against.
Usually the trunk parent entity.

stickSensitivity.name: stickSensitivity
stickSensitivity.description: Right stick sensitivity (degrees/sec at full tilt)

climbAlignSpeed.name: climbAlignSpeed
climbAlignSpeed.description: While climbing, how fast the camera yaws to behind the player

requestPointerLockOnMouseDown.name: requestPointerLockOnMouseDown
requestPointerLockOnMouseDown.description: If true, mousedown will request pointer lock (desktop).

climbAlignDuration.name: climbAlignDuration
climbAlignDuration.description: Align behind the player once when climbing starts (seconds).

enableCameraCollision.name: enableCameraCollision
enableCameraCollision.description: Enable camera collision (raycast) to prevent clipping through world.

collisionPadding.name: collisionPadding
collisionPadding.description: Keep camera slightly in front of the hit surface.

distanceSmoothness.name: distanceSmoothness
distanceSmoothness.description: How quickly the distance reacts to obstacles (higher = snappier).

remotePlayerEntityToClone.name: remotePlayerEntityToClone
remotePlayerEntityToClone.description: Remote player prefab entity to clone. Must have remotePlayerController.

localPlayerEntity.name: localPlayerEntity
localPlayerEntity.description: Local player root (the entity that has your existing playerController).

visualEntity.name: visualEntity
visualEntity.description: Visual child to rotate (same pattern as your local playerController.visualEntity). :contentReference[oaicite:10]{index=10}

textEntity.name: textEntity
textEntity.description: The Entity that has the text Element to update with the inputted text.
textEntity.title: Text Entity

placeHolder.name: placeHolder
placeHolder.description: Placeholder string to show when the input is empty.
placeHolder.title: Place Holder String

maxLength.name: maxLength
maxLength.description: Maximum length of the text input.
maxLength.title: Max Length

inputType.name: inputType
inputType.description: What type of input will this field accept. Changes keyboard layout on mobile.
inputType.title: Input Type

enterKeyHint.name: enterKeyHint
enterKeyHint.description: Change what the enter key shows on the virtual keyboard.
enterKeyHint.title: Enter Key Hint

dragDegPerScreenPercent.name: dragDegPerScreenPercent
dragDegPerScreenPercent.description:
Degrees per pixel of finger movement (tune).
This is conceptually similar to PlayerCameraFollower.mouseSensitivity. :contentReference[oaicite:7]{index=7}

itemTemplateAsset.name: itemTemplateAsset
itemTemplateAsset.description: Pooled UI item template (has ResourceUiAnimationItem on it)

itemsParent.name: itemsParent
itemsParent.description: Where pooled UI items should live in hierarchy (under a Screen)

worldCameraEntity.name: worldCameraEntity
worldCameraEntity.description: World camera used to convert world position to screen position

scatterRadius.name: scatterRadius
scatterRadius.description: UI scatter radius at spawn (in UI local units)

flyStartDelay.name: flyStartDelay
flyStartDelay.description: Delay before starting the fly, so the pop reads nicely

screenEntity.name: screenEntity
screenEntity.description: Disabled by default in the scene. Will be enabled on initialize.

panelEntity.name: panelEntity
panelEntity.description: Panel root to slide out (usually the big container under screenEntity).

leftArcEntities.name: leftArcEntities
leftArcEntities.description: Left arcs (3 image elements) between local monkey and cloud.

rightArcEntities.name: rightArcEntities
rightArcEntities.description: Right arcs (3 image elements) between cloud and remote monkeys.

remoteMonkeyHeadEntities.name: remoteMonkeyHeadEntities
remoteMonkeyHeadEntities.description: Remote monkey head entities (3 image elements).

statusTextEntity.name: statusTextEntity
statusTextEntity.description: Text element for "Connecting to the server..."

serverConnectedHoldSeconds.name: serverConnectedHoldSeconds
serverConnectedHoldSeconds.description: Delay after server connected (so the swap reads).

slideOutDistance.name: slideOutDistance
slideOutDistance.description: Slide out distance (UI local units, +X = right).

showOnlyOnce.name: showOnlyOnce
showOnlyOnce.description: Optional: if false, do not show again even if entity is re-enabled.

sampleAndLogPositions.name: sampleAndLogPositions
sampleAndLogPositions.description:
If true: samples positions then logs JSON to console.
If false: uses savedPositionsJson.

sampleCount.name: sampleCount
sampleCount.description: How many trees to sample (only used when sampleAndLogPositions = true).

edgeMargin.name: edgeMargin
edgeMargin.description: Avoid sampling too close to collider box edges (in local collider space).

yawOnly.name: yawOnly
yawOnly.description: If true, only randomize yaw (Y rotation).

maxTiltDegrees.name: maxTiltDegrees
maxTiltDegrees.description: Optional small tilt (degrees) when yawOnly=false (or even with yawOnly if you want).

densityCenterEntity.name: densityCenterEntity
densityCenterEntity.description: Density center: closer = higher acceptance probability.

densityFalloff.name: densityFalloff
densityFalloff.description: Distance (meters) where density reaches the minimum acceptance.

densityExponent.name: densityExponent
densityExponent.description: Shape of falloff curve (higher = denser near center, sparser far away).

minAcceptance.name: minAcceptance
minAcceptance.description:
Minimum acceptance probability far from density center (0..1).
Keep >0 if you still want some trees far away.

groundTag.name: groundTag
groundTag.description:
Ground filtering:
If set, raycast hits are only accepted if hit entity has this tag.
Leave empty to accept the first non-excluded hit.

maxAttemptsPerTree.name: maxAttemptsPerTree
maxAttemptsPerTree.description: Max attempts per accepted tree while sampling.

chunkCount.name: chunkCount
chunkCount.description: Must be 6 for your requested layout.

customizationType.name: customizationType
customizationType.description: Customization category/type (you can map to your CustomizationType enum later).

cameraFollowerEntity.name: cameraFollowerEntity
cameraFollowerEntity.description: Child entity used for the "customization camera". Should have a CameraHandler-derived script (cameraFollower recommended).

placeholderEntity.name: placeholderEntity
placeholderEntity.description: Placeholder entity shown when nobody is inside the zone.

dragRotateSensitivity.name: dragRotateSensitivity
dragRotateSensitivity.description: Player rotate sensitivity (deg per pixel) while dragging.

faceCameraDuration.name: faceCameraDuration
faceCameraDuration.description: How long to smooth-rotate the player to face the zone forward (seconds).

closeButtonEntity.name: closeButtonEntity
closeButtonEntity.description: Optional close button entity (must have Element component).

motionThreshold.name: motionThreshold
motionThreshold.description: Number of meters moved in one frame before CCD is enabled.
motionThreshold.title: Motion Threshold

sweptSphereRadius.name: sweptSphereRadius
sweptSphereRadius.description: This should be below the half extent of the collision volume. E.g., For an object of dimensions 1 meter, try 0.2.
sweptSphereRadius.title: Swept Sphere Radius

element.text:
[WASD/Arrow keys] Move
[Space Bar] Jump/Climb
[C] Drop off

bounceImpulse.name: bounceImpulse
bounceImpulse.description:
Extra upward impulse applied through PlayerController.
Final jump = normal jump logic + this bonus impulse.

cooldown.name: cooldown
cooldown.description: Small cooldown per entity so one contact does not spam bounce.

minApproachSpeed.name: minApproachSpeed
minApproachSpeed.description: Minimum speed into the trampoline top required to bounce.

minAboveTop.name: minAboveTop
minAboveTop.description:
Minimum player feet height above the trampoline origin, measured along
trampoline up. This rejects side and underside contacts.

footprintPadding.name: footprintPadding
footprintPadding.description: Extra horizontal footprint padding around the trampoline collision shape.

schema.name: minInterval
schema.description:
Minimum time between 2 plays of the same sound, in seconds.
Useful for footsteps / climb / spammy UI.

unloadMusicOnWorldUnload.name: unloadMusicOnWorldUnload
unloadMusicOnWorldUnload.description: If true, unload previous music asset on world unload.

oneShotEmitterTemplateAsset.name: oneShotEmitterTemplateAsset
oneShotEmitterTemplateAsset.description:
Template entity asset used for pooled positional one-shot sounds.
Must have a Sound component + audioEmitter script.

raycastTargetRoot.name: raycastTargetRoot
raycastTargetRoot.description:
Optional. If set, the side ray must hit this entity or one of its children
to consider the tested point valid.

Leave null if any blocking collider between the test point and the player is valid.

probeHeight.name: probeHeight
probeHeight.description:
Height used for the horizontal escape ray.
This avoids hitting the ground immediately.

groundOffset.name: groundOffset
groundOffset.description: Small vertical offset after finding the ground.

minGroundNormalY.name: minGroundNormalY
minGroundNormalY.description: Reject steep wall hits when raycasting down.

materialRefs.name: materialRefs
materialRefs.description: Skin id -> material mappings editable in the inspector.

schema.name: skinId
schema.description: Skin customization id that should prepare this material.

schema.name: sharedMaterialAsset
schema.description: Shared StandardMaterial to modify. This script does not clone it.

schema.name: emissiveTexture
schema.description: Optional emissive texture override. If empty, the material's emissiveMap is used.

schema.name: maskThreshold
schema.description: RGB threshold for treating an emissive texel as visible / non-black.

objectId.name: objectId
objectId.description:
Must match across every client for the same scene object.
Leave at 0 only for quick tests; the script will hash the entity name and start position.

minPositionDelta.name: minPositionDelta
minPositionDelta.description: Minimum position change in meters before a scheduled snapshot is sent.

minRotationDelta.name: minRotationDelta
minRotationDelta.description: Minimum angle change in degrees before a scheduled snapshot is sent.

interpolationSpeed.name: interpolationSpeed
interpolationSpeed.description: Remote interpolation speed. Higher values catch up faster.

snapDistance.name: snapDistance
snapDistance.description: Snap instead of smoothing when the remote target is this far away.

releaseAfterSleepingSeconds.name: releaseAfterSleepingSeconds
releaseAfterSleepingSeconds.description: Release ownership after the local rigidbody has slept for this long.

fieldZoneEntity.name: fieldZoneEntity
fieldZoneEntity.description:
Trigger volume that contains the football field.
The ball resets when it leaves this volume.

goalCooldownSeconds.name: goalCooldownSeconds
goalCooldownSeconds.description: Fail-safe to prevent repeated goal rewards from trigger spam.

fieldBorderEntities.name: fieldBorderEntities
fieldBorderEntities.description: Array of border entities that the ball can collide with.

shotTransformEntity.name: shotTransformEntity
shotTransformEntity.description: Empty entity used as the shot origin and local Z-axis direction.

audioEmitterEntity.name: audioEmitterEntity
audioEmitterEntity.description: Entity with an audioEmitter script and a Sound component.

maxPerformanceProfile.name: maxPerformanceProfile
maxPerformanceProfile.description:
Disable this entity when SaveData.performanceProfile is strictly higher than this.
Profiles are -1(best), 0, 1, 2, 3(worst).

normalRootEntity.name: normalRootEntity
normalRootEntity.description: Optional wrapper for all normal active/completed quest content.
